lore_so_far: Drop 1 (reveal): Bounti HQ's first ever bounty. As a boy he was a deckhand on a crew nobody remembers, and no one ever looked at him twice, so he bit a Curse Coin.
His Echo Coin turns one shout into ten thousand; every headline you could not scroll past and every 'YOU WON'T BELIEVE THIS' was his voice.
The price: he can never earn an honest coin again, so he sells noise. Last seen shouting from three harbours at once; his fleet is loud, cheap and very confident.
Drop 5 (return): when nobody answered his first poster he shrank (silence does that to him), got small enough to slip through the net, and hid under a pier for a week.

Four escapes in one week (him, the Butler, the Lure, Ten Thousand); every rumour on the docks ended with his name. He planned none of it and is taking the credit anyway: his Echo Coin shouts 'THE MASTERMIND RETURNS.' from every harbour. Small Fry have started saluting him and a few bigger ships are listening.

Bounty raised to 5,500,000 AURA 'for a plan he never made'. Bounti HQ says ignoring him only makes him shrink and slip away, so this time the hunters go loud: hit the target and the net closes mid-shout; miss it and the rumour comes true.
Verdict on drop 5: ESCAPED again (0 of 25 likes). Two escapes, two posters missed; the whole sea now calls him the Mastermind.

Drop 7 (Morwenna's story): Morwenna Salt offered him a cabin on her ship, a mirror on every wall and his name in lights, in exchange for his voice. He said yes before she finished the sentence. Her invites now go out through his Echo Coin: one 'You've been selected' becomes ten thousand in every harbour at once.

Drop 2 (reveal): for three years he ran the friendliest earning circle on the Open Sea, answered every question, welcomed every new hunter by name, and politely collected a small 'membership fee' from each. Nobody asked where the fees went.
One morning the circle woke up to nothing: no messages, no records, no admin. His Vanish Coin makes anything he wants gone disappear, and he made all of it vanish, himself included.
Last seen pushing his glasses up with one long nail, saying 'Right on schedule.' He cannot stand a plan that goes off script.
Drop 5 (Barnaby's story): his escape is told as 'the Butler vanished'.

Drop 6 (return): he surfaced as the admin of a brand new earning circle under a new name: warm welcomes, quick answers, a kind word for every new hunter, and a small polite 'membership fee' ('only a small one, for now').

An old member of his first circle recognised the long nail pushing up the glasses before every reply and posted a warning. By morning the post, her name in the circle's records and every message she had ever sent were gone (Vanish Coin: 'he makes you never have been there').

Rumour: the new circle runs on a date. Three days after drop 6 (around 2026-11-28) it is meant to wake up to nothing, exactly like the last one; he calls it 'right on schedule'. Hit the target before the date and the schedule breaks; miss it and another circle disappears. Bounty 28,000,000 AURA.

Drop 3 (reveal): her empire is a glittering ship with a thousand doors, out past the busy harbours. Every door is an invitation: free gifts, secret drops, 'You've been selected.' Hunters who step through never come back; their crews just stop hearing from them.
Her Lure Coin makes anything she sends look irresistible. Last week a whole crew followed one shiny invite to 'claim their spot'; nobody has seen them since, and the spots were never real.
Rumoured backstory: once the plainest girl on her island, laughed out of every room. She bit the coin so no one would ever look past her again. Her weakness is being ignored.
Verdict: ESCAPED (0 of 30 likes). Drop 5 (Barnaby's story): 'The Lure sailed off.'

Drop 7 (return): she does not believe Barnaby is a mastermind; she just wanted his voice. She recruited him with a cabin on her ship, a mirror on every wall and his name in lights. Every glittering invite from her ship now goes out through his Echo Coin, ten thousand times, in every harbour at once. The docks are full of hunters holding golden tickets to doors that lead nowhere.
Their pairing doubles the weakness: hers is being ignored, his is silence. Hit the target and the shouting turns on her; miss it and the invites never stop. Bounty 9,000,000 AURA.

Drop 4 (reveal): the biggest armada on the Open Sea, ten thousand ships, every deck cheering his name at once, every flag the same flag. Whole harbours give up on sight. The cheering never changes, not even by one word.

His Legion Coin splits him into thousands of empty copies that follow, cheer and swarm on command. Last week one copy limped into a quiet harbour, starving, begging for a single meal; the locals fed him, and by sunrise ten thousand more had docked.

Backstory as told: he once sailed to the far seas with a real fleet and a real war to win, lost all of it and came home with nothing but his pride, so he built an army that can never desert him (and can never truly fight for him). Weakness: one real fighter; test a single copy and the rest scatter. Threat on record: miss the target and Ten Thousand becomes twenty.
Verdict: ESCAPED (0 of 20 likes). Drop 5 (Barnaby's story): 'Ten Thousand became twenty thousand and marched away.' His armada now counts twenty thousand.
